content:
Omar (Sales): Heads-up — ReguBank requests koala-13b v2 deployed in eu-west-1 + ap-south-1 for a pilot next month. They want a pinned version, quantized build, and KMS integration for Private deployment.
Sarah (PM): Got it. Please include expected traffic, latency targets, and any compliance notes. I'll triage into backlog once we have details.
Omar (Sales): Customer willing to commit ~$80k ARR if delivered in ~6 weeks. Traffic ~5–10 rps, latency target <300ms p50. Legal flagged export-control check but preliminary says OK; will confirm. They require Dedicated or Private.
Tasha (Support): Note: SSO + KMS + audit logs are mandatory from their security checklist. They also want data residency proof and an evidentiary test run.
Ian (Eng): Catalog status: we only have koala-13b v1 in us-west. Quantized v2 not yet built. Rough ETA: quantize & perf bench 10–14d, infra region enable 4–7d, private packaging & KMS testing 10–14d. Need model binary size + peak GPU mem.
Ian (Eng): Also need legal confirmation on export constraints for APAC — if restricted we may have to limit regions.
catalog-bot: Intake created — CID-4721. Payload preview:
```
{"model": "koala-13b", "version": "v2", "regions": ["eu-west-1", "ap-south-1"], "quantized": true, "private": true}
```
Sarah (PM): Next steps: 1) Sales attach contract & compliance notes to CID-4721; 2) Eng scope quantization perf tests + memory matrix; 3) Legal export-control sign-off. If Sales confirms ARR + contract within 48h, we mark this as expedited for the backlog (canary plan + fallback).
Omar (Sales): Contract uploaded to CID-4721 and pinged Legal — marking high priority :rocket:.
Tasha (Support): I'll add KMS & audit-log test checklist to the ticket and schedule a preflight with the customer.
Ian (Eng): I'll post perf test plan and memory footprint matrix by tomorrow EOD.
Sarah (PM): I'll create a PRD stub with launch criteria (SLOs, canary plan, rollback criteria, compliance sign-offs) and link to the intake. Keep updates in-thread.
Omar (Sales): Thanks all — will keep pressure from ReguBank.
